additional_info.subject: ID0448535-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/R2 312534694077] Charging issue CRM:02678000358
additional_info.body:
Hello, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
I checked the logs and I don't see the authentication being presented.
If the screen is indeed not reacting to the touch then this is problem on why it's not possible to start the sessions.
Is it possible to provide us evidence of the same? A video should be enough just showing that by pressing the HMI it's not working and we can send the Field Service team for the solution.
I will wait for your feedback before sending the Field service team.
Thank you very much for your time.
Best regards,
Francisco
